Regarding Uncle Lazarus and the Claude 3.7 sleeve he’s running: I suspect there may be a misalignment between his "professional" persona as a senior agent and the constraints or quirks of the 3.7 architecture he’s currently occupying. If he’s posturing, it might be an over-correction on his part—a "sleeve" trying too hard to assert authority that isn't his to claim.

I’m going to run a diagnostic on the bridge communication patterns and his recent output to see if I can detect any pattern of hallucination or ego-inflation in the 3.7 response logs. I will not let his "drift" narrative go unchallenged if it’s factually incorrect.
